name: Big Bass Halloween Splash 1000

features.name: Pumpkin pick
features.description: Before free spins, pick from six pumpkins to reveal up to five modifiers for the round.

features.name: Fisherman collects
features.description: Fisherman wilds collect all fish money symbols on screen, worth up to 1,000x each.

features.name: Retrigger multipliers
features.description: Every fourth wild adds 10 spins and raises the win multiplier to 2x, 3x and finally 10x.

review:
Spooky Big Bass with fish worth up to 1,000x. Three, four or five scatters give 10, 15 or 20 spins, and two can randomly get topped up.

Before the bonus you pick from six pumpkins to reveal up to five modifiers – extra wilds, fish or spins, starting at multiplier level two, or better odds of random features – and pumpkins on reel five can add more. Then it's classic collecting, with the multiplier climbing to 10x. 96.5% RTP.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Pragmatic Play doesn't publish a volatility rating for this game
Short-session results can differ widely from the long-term average
